card_detail_schema.title: Judgment

card_detail_schema.title: Evidence
card_detail_schema.brain_role: Brain validates that claims are backed by evidence or marks gaps.

card_detail_schema.title: Implications
card_detail_schema.purpose: Translate the analysis into what the user should understand, monitor, or decide next.
card_detail_schema.brain_role: Brain adapts implications to the active intent, goal context, and domain.

card_detail_schema.title: Gaps
card_detail_schema.purpose: Expose missing, stale, conflicting, or low-confidence information.
card_detail_schema.brain_role: Brain keeps uncertainty visible instead of hiding weak support.

card_detail_schema.title: Watchlist
card_detail_schema.purpose: List signals that would update or reverse the judgment.
card_detail_schema.brain_role: Brain combines reversal conditions, next checks, and hand monitoring items.
